findings.issue: Required OPEN defaults had generic or behaviour-only plans.
findings.resolution: Sentinel-prefilled INQUIRE plans: ACCESS->SEQUENTIAL, ASYNCHRONOUS->NO, BLANK->NULL, DECIMAL->POINT, DELIM->NONE, FORM->FORMATTED for sequential and UNFORMATTED for direct or stream, PAD->YES, each citing its 12.10.2.x sentence.

findings.issue: Required default TOKENS were suppressed as unobservable because the processor's choice behind them is latitude.
findings.resolution: LEADING_ZERO and SIGN tokens asserted as PROCESSOR_DEFINED; ROUND asserted as membership in the six-token set of 12.10.2.28; ENCODING's DEFAULT token and STATUS's UNKNOWN token recorded as unobservable because INQUIRE reports the encoding form and has no STATUS=.

findings.issue: The POSITION default plan asserted INQUIRE(POSITION=) returns 'ASIS', but 12.10.2.24 reports the connection's positioning STATE, and a new file is positioned at its initial point (REWIND).
The replacement re-OPEN plan observed 12.5.6.1 p6 (position unaffected by a same-file re-OPEN), which holds regardless of POSITION's default.
findings.resolution: The omitted POSITION= token is recorded as not portably observable; same-connection position preservation is owned by S12.5.6.1-009.

review_rounds.decision: ACCEPTED by the coordinator after the reviewer's round-3 prescription
review_rounds.note: The round-4 change replaced one pending string with exactly the text the round-3 reviewer required; the coordinator verified the diff touches only that string and that S12.5.6.1-009 exists.

lesson: INQUIRE reports the STATE of a connection, which is not the same thing as the token an OPEN statement defaulted. A default token is observable through INQUIRE only when the inquiry is defined to return that token.
